## Summary

## Type of change
- [ ] Code (bug fix / feature / refactor)
- [ ] Research (docs/, research/)
- [ ] Benchmark scenario (benchmarks/, datasets/)
- [ ] Governance / principles change (`PRINCIPLES.md`, `GOVERNANCE.md`)

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass (`pytest`) if code changed
- [ ] Lint/type-check pass (`ruff check .`, `mypy`) if code changed
- [ ] Claims in research writing use the evidence-labeling convention (`RESEARCH.md`)
- [ ] If this changes `PRINCIPLES.md`: Ethics Council review requested (see `GOVERNANCE.md`)
